classification: All parameters in this file are proposed CASE assumptions; not measured workload or service-offer facts.
nominal_cost_rationale: 70USD/MWh is a rounded hypothetical remote tariff near the existing66.62USD/MWh merchant-only load-weighted comparator;50USD/MWh service premium is not empirically observed.
remote_emissions_rationale: Same annual grid factor as local proxy; no claim about a real remote region.
notice_scope: Notice available30minutes before event; all eligible actions apply for full hourly intervals; no unannounced/subhourly test.
remote_availability_scope: Remote capacity assumed available throughout local events; no remote network model.
tier2_scope: Canceled/interrupted service with a consequence charge; not deferred work awaiting completion.
tier_scope: Tier columns are net avoidable local AC MW; essential residual overhead is included in Tier0.
